sonnet.problem: This card re-asks a fact already asked in Stop 1 card 4. There the baker picked 'calf' as what Aaron made from the gold. Here the right answer 'Out came this calf' reuses that answer, and the baker can pick it from the earlier card alone.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
